thread:
Olivia Nguyen: Heads up — doing a preflight for the new customer project that needs A100 GPUs in europe-west4. Need help opening quota + billing preauth with GCP.

Olivia Nguyen: Requirements: dedicated GPU pool (A100 80GB), 8 GPUs initially, external static IPs for node egress, and a forwarding rule quota bump for LB. Project: redwood-priv-prod-2024. Billing account: 01A0B0-XXXXXX.

Mia Rodriguez: I can start the support case, need example justification and expected sustained vCPU/GPU hours.

Olivia Nguyen: Justification: private deployment for regulated customer, will run 24/7 inference for production traffic ~120k tokens/day, ~8 GPUs sustained, burst to 12 for peak. Will be in europe-west4 only.

Sam Lee: OK I'm creating the ticket. Opening as priority due to contract start date. Case: CAS-20240331-00123. Escalated to SE Karina.

infra-bot: Checklist: enable Compute Engine API, Service Usage API, Cloud Billing API; add billing account; confirm org IAM for service account. See: https://console.cloud.google.com/apis/library/compute.googleapis.com

Akshay Varma: Minimal gcloud commands to verify:
```
# confirm APIs
gcloud services enable compute.googleapis.com serviceusage.googleapis.com --project=redwood-priv-prod-2024
# show quotas for region
gcloud compute regions describe europe-west4 --project=redwood-priv-prod-2024
```

Mia Rodriguez: Added required justification and attached IAM screenshot to the case. Also requested quota increases: "Accelerator (A100) quota" from 0 -> 12, "External IPv4" from 8 -> 50, "Forwarding rules" from 8 -> 30.

GCP Support: Thanks, we've received CAS-20240331-00123. We've moved it to L2 for capacity validation. Requesting expected steady-state GPU hours per week and whether preemptible VMs are acceptable during bursts. Also need planned maintenance window for node provisioning (preferred 02:00-06:00 UTC).

Olivia Nguyen: Steady-state: ~8 GPUs * 24h * 7d = 1344 GPU hours/week. Bursts to 12 for up to 6 hours/day. Preemptible not acceptable for SLA-backed workloads. Maintenance window ok 02:00-06:00 UTC.

Karina SE: Looping in capacity team — I asked for an inventory check of europe-west4 (A100 availability). Also asked billing team to pre-authorize the project for quota release.

Sam Lee: Also note networking constraint: customer requires fixed egress IPs. If quota for external IPv4 is delayed, option is NAT with reserved addresses in a shared VPC — but still need address quota.

Mia Rodriguez: FYI I created a follow-up asking GCP to validate that A100 80GB SKUs are available in europe-west4 for new reservations. Included projected commit: 12 GPUs * 1 month as safety.

GCP Support: Update: case CAS-20240331-00123 assigned to Eng Ops (EU region). They've requested a PO or billing commitment doc to expedite static IPv4 allocation. Please upload to the case or reply with link.

Olivia Nguyen: Uploaded contract excerpt and PO reference: PO-RED-2024-089. Link added to case.

infra-bot: Auto-note — created internal tracking ticket INFRA-2319 to monitor quotas and provisioning steps. Assigned to Sam and Mia.

Sam Lee: Quick action items: 1) confirm service account roles: compute.admin + compute.networkAdmin + serviceusage.serviceUsageConsumer, 2) attach billing w/ BillingAccountUser, 3) share PO + contract on case.

Akshay Varma: If GCP delays external IPs we can provision nodes in a private subnet and use Cloud NAT — but NAT requires reserved IP quota too. Keep both requests.

GCP Support: New update: Eng Ops confirms A100 stock is available for reservation but final approval pending after billing confirmation. Target ETA: 48-72 hours. Will update CAS-20240331-00123.

Olivia Nguyen: Thanks. I'll mark customer timeline and push for the 48h window — they need capacity by next Tue. If we don't have confirmation by EOD tomorrow I'll escalate to account rep.

Mia Rodriguez: Noted. I'll ping account rep if no update by 18:00 UTC tomorrow.

Sam Lee: Leaving a small config note for ops: when provisioning the instance template, set --maintenance-policy=TERMINATE and pin GPUs with --reservation-affinity=any to match reservation workflow.

Olivia Nguyen: Thanks everyone. I'll update the case thread and this channel when GCP posts final approval. :thumbsup
